Build files, CMake definitions and the original source layout are retained in the source archive. Building the driver requires the Windows driver development environment documented by upstream. Signing material is not provided or exported; Aegis distributes the official signed installer without modification.
The driver is shared system software. Uninstalling Aegis preserves PawnIO; uninstall it separately through Windows if no other tool needs it.
